_comment: Manse chart natal position meanings per stem and branch cell (year/month/day/hour). Day stem is yourself, day branch your partner and close ties. Whole-pillar positions keep the pillar meaning from manseView-03. Authored in en, ja, zh-CN, zh-TW; other locales copy English.
